prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE landscape 16:9 genuine-looking 2D SIDE-VIEW GAMEPLAY SCREENSHOT for a small auto-running mine-cart platform game, exact title "ХрюША2026". Use the provided image ONLY as style and character reference: cheerful pink pig with red scarf in yellow mine cart, bold dark-blue outlines, flat cel shading, muted teal layered mine background, amber lamps, clean readable rails. Redesign the screen into plausible normal gameplay: pig and cart at LEFT THIRD, total sprite height 9-11% of frame, plenty of road visible ahead. The cart always auto-drives RIGHT. At this instant pig and cart are descending onto a small round GREEN SLIME ENEMY standing on lower rail: both cart wheels just contacting slime head, slime squash flat comically with a small yellow starburst, no gore. The cart is slightly tilted and pig raises ears with delighted determined expression, scarf trails left, SHORT soft white speed streak behind wheels. Main foreground route: a clear flat rail segment left, a short gap center-left that pig has just jumped, landing rail center-right with the slime, then a low wooden crate farther ahead and a small raised rail ledge. A curved line of FIVE small golden apple collectibles marks the safe jump route above the gap. Farther right a visible cyan gravity-switch gate stands beside the track, but this screen is NORMAL downward gravity; no upside down characters here. Enemies are small readable squashy mine slimes, not horses; a tiny bat on upper right is background hazard only. Simple repeated tile geometry, background darker and low contrast, clean collision surfaces, few particles. Minimal small native HUD: upper left tiny title "ХрюША2026" and three small hearts; upper right small distance "184 м", apple icon with "12", total "СЧЁТ 304". Score rule 1 point per meter +10 per apple, NO enemy score popups. No giant title, no bottom banner, no device frame, no collage, no poster composition, no 3D or pixel art. Make the gameplay clearer than the reference.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create one landscape 16:9 actual 2D SIDE-VIEW GAMEPLAY screenshot of "ХрюША2026", same small pink pig with red scarf in yellow mine cart as the reference. Bold dark navy cartoon outlines, crisp flat cel shading, simple repeated rail/rock tiles, quiet teal and indigo mine background, amber lamps plus a few small cyan crystals. THIS SCREEN SHOWS REVERSED GRAVITY: an UPPER rail runs horizontally at 22% frame height, supported by ceiling rock ABOVE it. Pig AND entire yellow cart are fully UPSIDE DOWN, positioned below the UPPER rail at left third; wheels point UP and touch the UNDERSIDE of the upper rail, pig's HEAD points DOWN into the tunnel. This is physically an inverted cart driving right along ceiling. Do NOT draw an upright pig on normal ground. The pig is secured in cart with a small belt. The upside-down scarf trails LEFT; pig looks RIGHT. Total pig/cart height 10% image height. Several small golden apples hang along a gentle upside-down arc below ceiling track over a clearly visible short GAP in the UPPER rail ahead, marking the inverted jump route. On ceiling track farther right, one tiny purple round slime is also inverted, its feet adhering upwards; hero can stomp it with wheels by bouncing UP into it under reversed gravity. Lower rail at bottom 75% has one spiked mine beetle and a large harmless-looking cyan switch arch, separated from hero by plenty of tunnel air. Small cyan UP arrow status at upper center signals gravity direction; small return-to-normal orange gravity arch at right end of upper path. Clarity of upside-down ride is highest priority. Camera remains horizontal, HUD remains upright! Tiny HUD upper left title "ХрюША2026", three hearts; upper right "1204 м", golden apple "46", "СЧЁТ 1664". No enemy score points. No giant titles or bottom banner, no 3D or pixel art, no collage. Looks like playable platform runner screenshot, not illustration.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a clean landscape 16:9 ANIMATION DIRECTION SHEET for 2D game "ХрюША2026", not a gameplay screenshot. Same precise pink pig with red scarf and small yellow wheeled mine cart as reference; dark navy outlines, cel-shaded flat colors. Pale desaturated ice-blue background. Heading top exact "ХрюША2026 · АНИМАЦИИ". Show EIGHT large clearly separated frames arranged two rows of four; no heavy panel boxes. Frames stay same camera SIDE VIEW and exact same consistent character identity/cart design. Top row is jump-stomp-bounce: Frame1 label "ПОДГОТОВКА" pig crouches low holding cart rim, suspension compressed, wheels on a short flat rail. Frame2 "ПРЫЖОК" cart airborne tilting nose slightly up, pig ears and red scarf stretch backward, a little dust on takeoff rail. Frame3 "ПРИДАВИЛИ!" cart lands wheels-first on a small squashed GREEN SLIME on rail, pig/cart squash 15%, funny soft yellow impact star, slime comically flat but no injury. Frame4 "ОТСКОК" cart automatically springs upward after stomp, pig delighted, knees and ears bouncing, short upward bounce trail; flattened slime below. Bottom row depicts gravity flip in four frames: Frame5 "СМЕНА ГРАВИТАЦИИ" upright airborne cart leaving lower track beside cyan up-arrow switch, scarf still downward. Frame6 "ПЕРЕВОРОТ" cart tilted 90 degrees counterclockwise in air, pink pig secured by small belt, circular short motion cue, scarf lags behind rotation. Frame7 "ПРИЛИПЛИ К ПОТОЛКУ" pig and cart entirely inverted, wheels UPWARD touching UNDERSIDE of a short upper ceiling rail, pig head DOWNWARD, compressed suspension on contact. Frame8 "ЕДЕМ ВВЕРХ НОГАМИ" same inverted cart runs RIGHT along underside upper rail, wheels above cart and head below, scarf trails LEFT, little wheel-motion tick. Contact rail in frames7/8 MUST be ABOVE character, bottom row inverted poses physically correct. Give character ears, scarf and face expressive follow-through, clear squash and stretch, short contained FX only. No giant arrows connecting frames, no horses, no weapons, no 3D or pixel art, no photorealism. Production useful attractive animation poses, clearly readable labels.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a landscape 16:9 LEVEL DESIGN ROUTE OVERVIEW for a huge FIXED, NON-RANDOM 2D SIDE-SCROLLING auto-runner titled exactly "ХрюША2026". This is a readable level blueprint with charming in-game art snippets, not a gameplay screenshot, not a fantasy world map. Clean dark navy background with twelve neatly aligned miniature SIDE-VIEW TRACK STRIPS in a 3-column by 4-row grid. Each strip is one 400-meter section of one fixed 4800-meter course. Strips show small yellow mine-cart/pink-pig icon, horizontal lower and/or ceiling rails, simple terrain cross sections, golden apple rows, small green slimes, cyan up-gravity gate and amber down-gravity gate. Preserve continuous LEFT-TO-RIGHT direction WITHIN EVERY strip; numbered arrows between strip cells indicate next section in reading order, never imply player reverses left. Main title upper left "ХрюША2026". Subtitle upper right "ОДНА ТРАССА · 4800 М · БЕЗ СЛУЧАЙНОСТИ". Twelve exact short cell labels, readable sans-serif, section number and distance range above each: 01 "СТАРТ" "0–400 м": gentle ordinary rails and easy apple arcs. 02 "ПРОВАЛЫ" "400–800 м": short gaps and slopes. 03 "СЛИЗНИ" "800–1200 м": stompable little green slimes. 04 "ПОТОЛОК" "1200–1600 м": cyan switch sends cart inverted to ceiling rail, little upward gravity arrows. 05 "КРИСТАЛЛЫ" "1600–2000 м": violet cave, ceiling gaps, cyan crystals. 06 "ШАХТЁРСКИЙ МОСТ" "2000–2400 м": ordinary downward gravity, wooden bridge gaps. 07 "ЛАВА" "2400–2800 м": short safe rail islands above orange lava. 08 "ВВЕРХ-ВНИЗ" "2800–3200 м": alternating pre-marked gravity switches and floor/ceiling routes. 09 "ОБВАЛ" "3200–3600 м": visible falling-rock warning shapes, broken rails. 10 "ЯБЛОЧНЫЙ РИСК" "3600–4000 м": optional higher-risk apple line near gap, safe lower route. 11 "РАЗГОН" "4000–4400 м": long jumps and fast rails. 12 "ФИНИШ" "4400–4800 м": final combine gravity/stomp/gap sequence, chequered finish banner. Tiny bottom legend with 4 icons labelled "ЯБЛОКИ", "СЛИЗЕНЬ", "ГРАВИТАЦИЯ ↑", "ГРАВИТАЦИЯ ↓". Tiny footer exact "СЧЁТ = МЕТРЫ + 10 × ЯБЛОКИ". Each track strip must remain wide enough to read route, enough whitespace between cells; use small simplified tiles, no dense paragraphs, no large character portraits. Strong visual grouping by biome colors but same clean 2D dark-blue outlines, teal mine, yellow cart, pink pig. No horses, no bubble weapons, no 3D perspective, no isometric map, no photorealism. This is a clear reference for the order of sections, not an executable level asset.
